## Functions

### toastUndo()

```ts
function toastUndo(options): string | number;
```

Show a done-and-undoable toast: the action is deferred while a fuse burns along
the toast's edge, Undo or Escape cancels it, and resting on the toast holds the
fuse. Returns the toast id.
